title: Trusted External Reconstruction and True Process-Boundary Restart Qualification
qualified_scope: committed-boundary process restart across complete producer-process termination
adapter-owned external representation outside the kernel
atomic reconstruction of a complete provenance record plus decoded physical continuation state
opaque typed persistence carrier reconstruction followed by the existing F-KT12 restore seam
stable lineage, committed revision and generic committed time across processes
exact next checkpoint and next candidate provenance
zero physical transfer caused by reconstruction/restore
complete interval water ledger without starting-storage reset or double count

trust_boundary.note: The language-level public trusted constructor is an explicit architecture seam, not a cryptographic or capability-security boundary. Its correctness depends on adapter admission and qualification; ordinary runtime code must not use it as a mutation shortcut.

remaining_before_operational_restart: qualify codecs for real SWAP continuation-state owner types and active optional feature state
bind stable runtime template/layout identities to those codecs
qualify MultiSWAP many-column checkpoint/restart and batching behavior
define operational adapter storage/error/recovery policy outside the kernel
qualify schema evolution or migration explicitly before accepting cross-version restart artifacts
